Here are today’s headlines – the latest news in the Philippines and around the world:

items: Senate court lowers conviction voting threshold in Duterte impeachment trial

blocks.text: The Senate impeachment court votes to lower the voting threshold for the conviction of Vice President Sara Duterte in her impeachment trial.

items: Sara Duterte trial: Prosecution gets more viable conviction path after threshold ruling

blocks.text: The impeachment court ruling that bars absentee senators from voting in Vice President Sara Duterte’s trial gives the prosecution a more feasible path to securing her conviction.

items: Auditors flag gaps, missing docs in OVP’s P168-M disaster aid

blocks.text: A government audit finds gaps and missing records in the office of Vice President Sara Duterte’s over P168-M disaster relief aid.

items: Bus operators appeal to lift fare hike freeze as fuel prices soar

blocks.text: Bus operators call on the government to immediately lift the suspension of fare increases approved by regulators in March. This, as fuel prices continue to rise.

items: Trend Intel: In this economy?! Why young Filipinos choose to live alone

blocks.text: More young Filipinos are exploring solo-living. The Philippine Institute for Development Studies in 2024 reported the percentage of one-person households in the country more than doubled within three decades, from 2.9% in 1990 to 9.1% in 2020. – Rappler.com
